items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We’re booking a tour with Nancy Wilson, actually with the big band.

ctx.x: And you’re going on tour coming up with any of your groups soon?

Yeah. We’re booking a tour with Nancy Wilson, actually with the big band. And our first concert is going to be at the Tanglewood jazz weekend this Labor Day. And we’re doing our fourth CD in May, a live CD, we’re doing five dates with Diana Schur at the Manchester Craftsman’s Guild, which is a phenomenal place in Pittsburgh, like very state-of-the-art audio/video recital hall. It’s an amazing, amazing place. And we’re going to record all five halves of our concert and hopefully we’ll get one good live CD out of…
Well I wish you luck in all that juggling.
